sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide students with training in handling diverse, large-scale, biomolecular datasets and in extracting biologically meaningful information from them
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Use programming language (such as R, Python, Bash) to perform basic analyses tasks. B. Apply appropriate bioinformatics and AI tools to conduct a research project in this area. C. Critically analyse and process high-throughput biomolecular data. D. Appraise, integrate and present different types of bioinformatic data in appropriate formats. E. Apply appropriate statistical tools to analyse bioinformatics data.
